verdict.rationale: Retell documents agent versioning: new versions start as editable drafts, and `prod` and `staging` tags point at specific versions. Agent versions can be created, published, listed and fetched via MCP, and Conductor proposes edits for review before they are applied. Rollback is only implied by re-pointing a tag such as prod at an earlier version (e.g. V2 while V3 is tested), and is never documented as an explicit operation. Missing for 10: an explicit documented rollback/revert workflow, version diff or change-history review, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
